name: Premium Nighttime Home Cinema

environment.type: high-end residential home cinema integrated into a contemporary living room
environment.architecture: floor-to-ceiling dark-framed windows along the left wall with a nighttime city view; dark concrete-textured television feature wall; warm neutral ceiling with recessed spotlights; light natural wood floor
environment.layout: large wall-mounted widescreen television on the right-hand feature wall; low dark wooden media cabinet beneath it; deep charcoal L-shaped sectional sofa facing the screen from the left foreground; low rectangular wood coffee table in the foreground
furnishings: plush charcoal sectional sofa with chaise section, neutral cushions and a soft throw
low wooden media console with open shelving
slim black soundbar centered below the screen
low wooden coffee table with books, remote control and a small glass bowl
narrow illuminated display shelves recessed beside the feature wall
environment.people: two seated viewers on the sofa, seen in partial side view, naturally watching the television; their specific identities and wardrobes are not defined by this environment

screen.content_rule: screen imagery is an independent replaceable content layer, not part of the permanent room design
screen.default_content: colorful cinematic science-fiction space scene featuring a spacecraft against bright blue, magenta and amber nebula clouds

lighting.ambient: dim warm evening lighting with restrained recessed ceiling downlights
lighting.accent: soft warm LED backlighting outlining the television; concealed warm strip lights inside architectural shelving
lighting.practical: subtle small side lamp and gentle reflections on the windows
lighting.screen_glow: soft color spill from the displayed content, without overwhelming the room

camera.framing: wide interior establishing shot showing sofa in left foreground and television wall on the right
camera.viewpoint: slightly elevated three-quarter room view, looking diagonally toward the feature wall
camera.perspective: natural room proportions, straight architectural lines, no extreme distortion
camera.aspect_ratio: 1:1 reference composition; adaptable to other output ratios

style: ultra-photorealistic premium architectural interior photography, believable natural materials, precise furniture geometry, controlled reflections, cinematic low-light exposure
swap_rule: Reference this environment ID to preserve the room layout, materials, furniture and architectural lighting. Replace the television image independently without redesigning the environment.
constraints: Do not permanently embed any movie title or lettering into the room architecture
Keep the television screen separate from the room and its furniture
Maintain a plausible residential scale and natural seating orientation
Preserve the nighttime window views and warm architectural accent lighting
